title: R = receipt(A): identity, authority, consequence, replay, standing + ALOOP execution provenance
description: v2: adds work_order_id, origin_authority, provider, provider_execution_id (required), optional subject_before/subject_after digests, identity.subject_digest for non-commit (sha256/blake3 pack) subjects riding on a commit anchor, and the namespaced provider extension map (provider_ext.<provider>). The top level stays OPEN; the validator (not this schema) refuses un-namespaced extension keys and enforces that identity.subject_sha is a real git commit (or the receipt routes a non-commit subject through identity.subject_digest).

work_order_id.description: id of the work order this execution discharged (ALOOP ExecutionRequest.work_order)

grant.description: lease id, user decision reference, or NONE

origin_authority.description: the authority under which the ExecutionRequest originated; events on the chain must match it (authority-mismatch falsifier)

name.description: execution provider identity (ALOOP ExecutionProvider); rewrites of this name against one provider_execution_id are an identity falsifier

provider_execution_id.description: provider-side execution identifier; joins receipts to the OCEL event chain

subject.description: work order id or artifact name

subject_sha.description: git commit anchor; MUST resolve as a commit in identity.repo when the validator can see it locally. Non-commit digests (sha256/blake3 pack digests) NEVER go here — put them in subject_digest.

subject_digest.description: explicit alternate identity for NON-COMMIT subjects (pack digests); the commit anchor in subject_sha stays the verifiable anchor, the digest rides here

subject_before.description: optional digest of subject state before execution

subject_after.description: optional digest of subject state after execution

event_ids.description: OCEL event ids this receipt claims; every actuation event must be claimed by >=1 receipt or it is an unreceipted actuation

chain_head_hash.description: BLAKE3/hash-chain head this receipt binds to

predecessor_work_order_ids.description: prior receipts this one replays from or extends; DAG edges

replay_binding.description: how this receipt binds to the event chain and predecessor receipts (causal DAG edges)

grant.description: lease id, user decision reference, or NONE

durable_location.description: path tracked in git or CI artifact, never gitignored tmp

derived_from.description: which replay command(s) at which subject_sha justify the value
